name: r-code
description: One elegant home for Claude Code, Codex and Pi.
author: Ryan (Rybib)

scripts.dist:dmg: node scripts/fetch-axe.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: R-Code uses the microphone for on-device Whisper dictation.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: R-Code and its coding agents use Apple Events to open Terminal for sign-in and to control apps you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Your coding agents read and change files in Desktop when you work there.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Your coding agents read and change files in Documents when you work there.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Your coding agents read and change files in Downloads when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Your coding agents read and change files on external drives when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Your coding agents read and change files on network drives when you ask them to.
